<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!-- internal parameter entity comment -->">
  %pe;
  <!ENTITY ent "General Entity Value">
  <?pi-target processing instruction data?>
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/sub">
  <!-- Top level comment -->
  <sub:child>
    <![CDATA[ CDATA section containing <tags> & entities like &ent; ]]>
  </sub:child>
  &ent;
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section*)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ext SYSTEM "http://localhost/external.dtd">
  <!ENTITY ent "EntityText">
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
]>
<doc xmlns="http://test.org/ns" xmlns:m="http://test.org/ns/meta">
  <!-- Comment in root -->
  <m:section>
    <?target data?>
    <![CDATA[
      Some more CDATA with &ent; and markup-like text <foo></foo>
    ]]>
  </m:section>
</doc>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e1 "Value 1">
  <!ENTITY e2 "Value 2 &e1;">
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ELEMENT nested (#PCDATA)>">
  %param;
  <?xml-pi-test attr="val"?>
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/catalog" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Comment describing catalog items -->
  <item>
    <?processing-instruction test?>
    <![CDATA[
      <nested>This is raw CDATA text with &e2;</nested>
    ]]>
  </item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE note [
  <!ELEMENT note (to,from,body)>
  <!ELEMENT to (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT from (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT body (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY writer "John Doe">
  <!ENTITY recipient "Jane Doe">
  <!ENTITY % dtd_comment "<!-- DTD internal subset comment -->">
  %dtd_comment;
  <?xml-stylesheet href="style.css" type="text/css"?>
]>
<note xmlns="http://www.w3.org/TR/html4/" xmlns:custom="http://example.com/custom">
  <!-- Document header comment -->
  <custom:header>
    <?custom-pi action="process"?>
    <![CDATA[
      <!-- Nested comment-like syntax inside CDATA -->
      <to>&recipient;</to>
      <from>&writer;</from>
    ]]>
  </custom:header>
  <body>Hello World!</body>
</note>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "BaseEntity">
  <!ENTITY derived "&base; Extended">
  <!ENTITY % markup "<!ELEMENT subdata (#PCDATA)>">
  %markup;
  <?pi-target data="value"?>
]>
<document xmlns="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/" xmlns:ns1="http://example.com/ns1">
  <!-- Start of document comment -->
  <ns1:content>
    <?target-instruction param="data"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block containing special characters: <, >, &, ', "
      and entity reference simulation: &derived;
    ]]>
  </ns1:content>
</document>
```
